progress.text: (M10, OCR models): Model staging downloads and verifies the ONNX pair after the upstream RTEN URL brownout; runtime discovery prefers complete ONNX pairs per directory, retains complete RTEN fallback and preserves directory precedence.

(M10, #4158 partial): Word, HTML, RTF and PowerPoint export keep a block that continues another on its line (an italic case name, a link, a superscript) as a run in its own style inside that paragraph, with the source's word space, instead of a paragraph of its own. Style changes that wrap onto the next line still split paragraphs (the reading blocks keep style boundaries). Estimates unchanged.

(M3, window move on Wayland, #3970 follow-up): After a move or resize by PdfCraft's own title bar or edges, the button release given back to egui goes before the pointer leaving the window, so hover no longer sticks at the old place until the pointer moves. Found by CodeRabbit in review of #3970; a unit test covers it. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, #4253): The annotation quick bar remembers Keep tool selected across restarts, including unpinning. Old and malformed settings keep safe defaults; the opt-in UI control channel reads and changes the same preference. Estimates unchanged.

(M7, #4280): Edit text names each standard stand-in font after its face (PCEdTimesBold, ...) instead of one shared PCEdHelv. Rewriting a bold paragraph whose subset lacks an accent no longer repoints the paragraphs set earlier in a regular stand-in at Times-Bold, and the editor's frame stays on the paragraph being edited. Pages saved by older builds keep their shared name and are not repaired. Estimates unchanged.

(M8, #3205 follow-up): Phone-pattern redaction matches complete labelled Italian geographic numbers such as Tel. +39 0426/123456, with synthetic matcher and mark/apply/save/reopen coverage; unlabelled international slash numbers remain unsupported.

(M7, #2636 partial): A new PasteContent edit pastes an added text box or image copied in the same document or another, keeping its style, picture, turns, flips and crop, as one undo step; contentcopy drives it headlessly. A paste lands beside earlier copies (18 pt steps) and stays on the page. A pasted image reuses its picture object in its own document and after the first paste into another; there a colour profile is dropped and CMYK colours stored losslessly are turned to RGB. The desktop keys and menus follow in separate PRs. Estimates unchanged.
(M11, optimizer resolution): Image downsampling includes each page's /UserUnit scale, preserving images already below the physical resolution threshold, including shared nested forms.
(M10, Word table widths): Word export sizes each cell from the grid columns it spans, keeping unequal columns and cells after a merged cell consistent with the table grid.
(M10, table continuation text): Office exporters retain text from table slots covered by another cell's span as paragraph text.
(M10, image export): Soft-mask Decode intervals preserve partial opacity in Export all images and Save Image As.
(M10, print resources): Vector printing preserves original page artwork when existing XObjects use annotation resource names.
(M4, #3916 partial): Document edits and Undo/Redo cancel an Organize page drag. Pointer-release regressions check exact page order and save/reopen.

(M10, #3752 paper): CUPS jobs ask for the chosen paper in every size. The 13 sizes the Print dialog sent no paper for (A6, A0–A2, ARCH, ANSI C–E) use PWG 5101.1 names, checked against a synthetic PPD with cupsfilter, and docprint to a printer sends the paper too. The macOS tray half (Auto Select instead of the PPD's default tray) is a craft-print change that needs a pin bump here. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, macOS association recovery candidate): Successful desktop open/save/sign can queue recovery of an existing per-file binding to the running PDFCraft bundle through NSWorkspace. Metadata-only watcher changes retain undo and avoid false overwrite prompts; real same-length/same-mtime edits remain protected. Rebased on 0.12.0 and reuses #3042's shared atomic metadata preservation; the bounded recovery parser does not narrow save limits. Prior native Preview TEST-signature and Finder workflows passed on macOS 27.0.1; other versions remain unqualified. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, comment threads): Replies join the comment their /IRT references, not every comment sharing its /NM; PyMuPDF names each page's first comment fitz-A0, so all replies used to land under page 1. The Comments header counts comments without their replies, with the number of replies in small text under it (in every catalogue), and a reply's thread line runs from the avatar above it to its own. A reply to a reply shows in its thread in the panel too (it was listed nowhere), an /IRT that leads to no comment (itself, a loop, a pop-up, an unlisted object) leaves its annotation a comment of its own instead of hiding it (a status or checkmark that leads nowhere is listed nowhere), and a Replace Text caret isn't counted as a reply. The comment tools refuse an id several comments share instead of acting on the first (page 1's), and take page + index for those; commentlist reads a status or checkmark from the annotation it was set on, as the panel does, and reports a reply's own on the reply. UI, engine and automation regressions cover it. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, #3107 / PR #3438): Inline-image parsing falls back to the existing EI heuristic when missing declared samples, headers or terminators exceed the content-window budget, instead of waiting for an impossible allocation. Exact-length parsing for available samples and ordinary large streamed images is retained. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, calculation scripts): The Calculate tab and a rename read simplified field notation only from a comment, where Acrobat writes it: a string that spells BVCALC … EVCALC is no longer taken for the notation, or rewritten by a rename. A / after the condition of if, while, for or with starts a regular expression, so a rename no longer rewrites a name inside one, and a quote inside one no longer hides the getField calls after it. Both found in review of #3550. A // comment ends at \r, U+2028 or U+2029 as well as \n, so in a script with \r line endings the code after one is no longer hidden from a rename, or taken for the notation. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, JPEG and TIFF export): Export ▸ Image as JPEG or TIFF refuses a raster that is not exactly width × height pixels, as PNG export has since #2425. A raster a pixel short panicked inside the JPEG and TIFF encoders, and a partial pixel at the end was dropped and the rest written as a valid image. Rendered pages are always the right size, so what exports is unchanged. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, window resize and move on Wayland): With PdfCraft's own title bar on GNOME/Wayland, a second resize by a window edge, or a second move by the empty tab strip, works straight after the first; it waited for a click inside the window, because the compositor keeps the button's release from egui. A unit test covers the release given back; checked by hand in a test build. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3808): Page thumbnails in the Inspector can be resized independently from the document and Organize, with a slider, buttons and thumbnail-zoom control option. Selection, page following and reload are covered by regressions. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, Brazilian Portuguese): Completed the pt-br catalog against the current 2,674-key union, including signature validation and accessibility messages; no build or compilation run. Localization remains partial because help and unpredictable engine/OS error details are not translated.
(M14, #3557): Preferences: the OK button stays below the scrolling settings instead of being the last thing in them, so it is in reach in a short window.

(M4, initial view): Window and interface options read indirect boolean ViewerPreferences values. Synthetic regressions cover true/false, direct/indirect preference dictionaries and save/reopen; malformed entries retain false defaults. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3535): Escape with a menu open closes the menu and keeps the text selection; the next Escape clears it, as before. One keypress used to do both. A synthetic UI regression checks it. Estimates unchanged.
(M11, #3507): Image merging keeps trailing comments, split operands and graphics state across content streams. Synthetic tool tests check saved text, rendered regions and exact image rows.

(M6, calculation order page): Prepare a form ▸ Calculation order, a page of its own, lists the calculated fields in the order they calculate with their formulas and values, moved with Up/Down arrows (as Acrobat's Set Field Calculation Order), Alt+↑/↓ or by dragging. A card says what is wrong with the order and holds Fix order; a loop has a card of its own that opens one of its formulas. On the page, each calculated field shows its step, and arrows show what the field in focus reads and what reads it. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, calculation order): The order a form's fields calculate in (/CO) is read, checked, fixed and set headlessly with formcalculationorder: it says which fields read one calculated later (they show stale values), which read each other in a loop, and which the PDF's order leaves out; Fix order moves only what must move, in one undo step, and the form recalculates. Editing a formula no longer moves its field to the end of the order, and a field the order lists twice calculates once. Estimates unchanged.
(M2, #3574): Forms without Resources use page Properties for ActualText and layer visibility. Synthetic tests cover boundaries, nested/shared forms, and save/reopen. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, PR #3348 review): Tracking samples retain short repeated punctuation (up to four glyphs), keeping tracked ellipses intact and searchable while longer TOC leaders still preserve title word spaces. Synthetic regressions cover isolated and surrounded ellipses. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, #3601): A missing spacing glyph in an OpenType substitute uses its ordinary-space glyph. Synthetic Japanese CID renderer tests check blank spaces, /W and /DW placement, and unchanged Unicode extraction. Font selection and embedded fonts are unchanged. Estimates unchanged.

(M12, #3673): Character encoding accepts Identity-H/V fonts with Adobe CJK collections and recognizes predefined non-Identity CMaps independently. Unknown CMaps and foreign registries remain refused; synthetic checker and read-only automation regressions passed after failing before the fix. Per-glyph mapping validation and embedded-font extraction remain separate. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, #3502): Form detection preserves comments across content streams and does not add fields over rectangles hidden by those comments. Synthetic tests cover visible controls, graphics state, and saved field inventories. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, #2273 / PR #2279): Rebased the field-highlight default and Appearance preference onto main, retaining secured-form parity evidence and updating secured AcroForm/XFA toggle expectations. Build and test validation delegated to GitHub CI. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, reshape lines): A line or arrow could only be moved after it was drawn; its length and angle stayed. A selected line, connected lines, polygon or cloud now has a handle on each end or corner: dragging one reshapes it (Shift holds it to 45°), as one undo step, with the new shape drawn while dragging. pdfcraftannot::setpoints, Edit::ReshapeAnnotation, commentedit points; comment lists carry the points. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3620): Overlapping comment hover uses the original annotation index independently of spatial inspection order. A synthetic UI regression covers different annotation upper edges. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3541/#3620): Comment hover follows the individual marked lines instead of the enclosing multiline rectangle, and overlapping comments follow paint order. Synthetic UI regressions cover all four text-markup kinds, page/view rotations, neighboring highlights, legacy rectangle fallback and unchanged PDF bytes. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, #3532 partial): Vector printing retains existing widget artwork when its appearance lacks Subtype. A print-owned copy adds Form dispatch metadata. The source stream and all explicit subtypes stay unchanged. Synthetic source/output raster checks cover resources, selected/shared appearances, placement, flags and content modes. Appearance regeneration and physical printer validation remain outside this fix. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, arrow keys move comments): With a comment selected, the arrow keys move it a screen pixel and ⌘/Ctrl or Shift and an arrow ten, instead of scrolling the view or turning the page; up is up on screen at any zoom and rotation, and each press is one undo step. Text markup and locked comments stay put. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, Spanish catalog gaps): es.tsv gains the 143 (context, English) keys the other catalogs carried and it was missing, so Spanish covers the whole bundled key union like Lithuanian and Vietnamese: calendar months and weekdays, the certificate context, X.509 key usages, signature-revision and digital-ID lines, password validation, eight plural messages, the combine-from-folder strings, the rendering and stale-file notices and the shortcut-spelled tooltips. Counts in localization-parity.md re-measured against the current union (vi restated against it for the same reason). Status stays partial: no translated help, and OS details stay outside the catalog. Estimates unchanged.
